title: In Addition
subtitle: 「此外／而且」，究竟是哪一種補充方式？
description: 「此外／而且」，究竟是哪一種補充方式？

words.note: 最常見、最自然的近義詞之一，用來補充另一項相關資訊；位置通常在主要動詞前、be 動詞後，或句首。
words.example: The programme is affordable and also easy to use.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃價格合理，而且也很容易使用。

exercises.original: The software is easy to install. In addition, it requires very little maintenance.
exercises.zh: 這套軟件容易安裝，而且幾乎不需要維護。

options.explanation: however = 會表示轉折，但兩項都是優點。
therefore = maintenance 並不是由 easy installation 推導出的結果。
also = 第二句只是再補充一項優點，因此 also 最自然。
similarly = 未在比較兩個相似對象。

exercises.original: She speaks French. In addition, she understands Italian.
exercises.zh: 她會說法語，也懂意大利語。

options.explanation: instead = 不是用 Italian 取代 French。
therefore = 懂 Italian 不是因為會 French 的必然結果。
however = 兩項能力沒有對比。
also = 這是加入另一項能力，用 also 最直接。

exercises.original: The course includes lectures. In addition, students complete practical exercises.
exercises.zh: 課程包括講課，學生也會完成實務練習。

options.explanation: therefore = practical exercises 不是 lectures 的結果。
similarly = 沒有平行比較兩個主體。
also = lectures 之外再補充另一個課程元素，因此 also 很自然。

words.note: 較正式，常用於書面論證，在前一點之上再補充一項支持性的資訊。
words.example: The proposal is practical. Furthermore, it can be implemented quickly.
words.exampleZh: 這項建議很實際。此外，它可以迅速實施。

exercises.original: The policy could reduce costs. In addition, it may improve service quality.
exercises.zh: 這項政策可以降低成本。此外，它可能改善服務質素。

options.explanation: however = 兩點方向一致，不是轉折。
therefore = 改善 service quality 不是前句的必然結果。
furthermore = 正式論證中加入另一項支持理由，furthermore 很貼切。
similarly = 不是比較相似情況。

exercises.original: The report is well researched. In addition, its recommendations are practical.
exercises.zh: 這份報告研究充分，而且建議實際可行。

options.explanation: therefore = recommendations practical 不是 research quality 的直接推論。
similarly = 不在比較兩份報告。
furthermore = 兩項都是對 report 的正面支持，正式地可用 furthermore。

exercises.original: The treatment is inexpensive. In addition, it can be delivered in local clinics.
exercises.zh: 這項治療成本低。此外，它可以在本地診所提供。

options.explanation: therefore = 可在 clinics 提供不是低成本的必然結果。
furthermore = 加入第二個獨立優點時，furthermore 是正式自然的銜接語。

words.note: 正式書面語，常用來加入另一項同方向、而且往往更有力的論點。
words.example: The new system is cheaper. Moreover, it is easier to maintain.
words.exampleZh: 新系統更便宜，而且更容易維護。

exercises.original: The new model uses less energy. In addition, it is cheaper to repair.
exercises.zh: 新型號耗能較少，而且維修成本也較低。
exercises.upgrade: moreover · 此外；而且；更重要的是

options.explanation: therefore = 維修較便宜並非耗能低的結果。
moreover = 第二點進一步強化正面論點，moreover 很自然。

exercises.original: The location is convenient. In addition, the rent is lower than expected.
exercises.zh: 地點方便，而且租金比預期低。
exercises.upgrade: moreover · 此外；而且；更重要的是

options.explanation: however = rent lower 並不與 convenient 對立。
moreover = 在第一個優點後再加入一個有力優點，moreover 很合適。

exercises.original: The evidence is recent. In addition, it comes from several independent sources.
exercises.zh: 證據很新，而且來自數個獨立來源。
exercises.upgrade: moreover · 此外；而且；更重要的是

options.explanation: moreover = 第二點進一步提高 evidence 的可信度，因此 moreover 最貼切。
therefore = 來源獨立不是證據新近的結果。
likewise = 不是兩個對象的相似性。

words.note: 正式而中性，常用於報告、說明和學術寫作，表示再加入一項資訊。
words.example: Additionally, all participants will receive a written guide.
words.exampleZh: 此外，所有參加者都會收到一份書面指南。

exercises.original: All participants receive a handbook. In addition, they have access to online materials.
exercises.zh: 所有參加者都會收到手冊。此外，他們亦可使用網上教材。

options.explanation: therefore = online access 不是 handbook 的結果。
additionally = 正式中性地補充另一項提供內容，additionally 很自然。

exercises.original: The building has new insulation. In addition, solar panels have been installed.
exercises.zh: 大樓已加裝新隔熱層。此外，亦已安裝太陽能板。

options.explanation: additionally = 報告式列舉第二項措施時，additionally 很合適。
instead = solar panels 沒有取代 insulation。
therefore = 安裝 solar panels 不是 insulation 的結果。

exercises.original: The package includes breakfast. In addition, guests receive free airport transport.
exercises.zh: 套票包括早餐。此外，住客可享免費機場接送。

options.explanation: additionally = 這只是再加入一項 package benefit，因此 additionally 最精確。
therefore = airport transport 不是 breakfast 的結果。

words.note: 較口語，可用來補充另一個理由或事實；句首時常帶有『而且／再說』的語氣。
words.example: The apartment is close to work. Besides, the rent is reasonable.
words.exampleZh: 這間公寓離工作地點很近，而且租金合理。

exercises.original: We should choose this route because it is shorter. In addition, it avoids the busiest roads.
exercises.zh: 我們應選這條路，因為它較短；而且它避開最繁忙的道路。

options.explanation: besides = 較口語地補充另一個理由時，句首 Besides 很自然。
however = 第二點不是反駁第一點。
therefore = avoid roads 不是 shorter 的結果。

exercises.original: I don't want to buy another printer. In addition, the old one still works perfectly.
exercises.zh: 我不想再買打印機；而且舊的仍然運作良好。

options.explanation: therefore = 若用 therefore，會把句子改成明確因果；原句是補充理由。
besides = 第二句作為額外理由支持前句，口語中 Besides 很貼切。
instead = 沒有描述替代方案。

exercises.original: The venue is too small. In addition, it is difficult to reach by public transport.
exercises.zh: 場地太小，而且乘公共交通也很難到達。

options.explanation: however = 兩項都是缺點，不是對比。
therefore = 交通不便不是場地小造成的。
besides = 在第一個缺點上再加一個理由，Besides 很自然。

words.note: 較口語、有強調感，用來加入一項進一步支持前面觀點的資訊。
words.example: The course is free, and what's more, it includes all the materials.
words.exampleZh: 這門課免費，而且還包括所有教材。

exercises.original: The service is free. In addition, users do not need to create an account.
exercises.zh: 這項服務免費，而且用戶毋須建立帳戶。
exercises.upgrade: what's more · 而且；更重要的是

options.explanation: what's more = 口語中加入另一項值得強調的優點，What's more 很自然。
therefore = 免開帳戶並非免費的結果。

exercises.original: The hotel is near the station. In addition, all rooms have sea views.
exercises.zh: 酒店鄰近車站，而且所有客房都有海景。
exercises.upgrade: what's more · 而且；更重要的是

options.explanation: therefore = sea views 不是 near station 的結果。
what's more = 第二個優點更吸引人，What's more 有自然的強調感。

exercises.original: The repair was completed early. In addition, it cost less than the original estimate.
exercises.zh: 維修提早完成，而且費用低於原先估算。
exercises.upgrade: what's more · 而且；更重要的是

options.explanation: however = 兩項都是正面結果。
therefore = 成本較低不一定由提早完成直接造成。
what's more = 口語地強調第二個額外好處，What's more 很貼切。

words.note: 常放在句尾，語氣自然、口語化，表示在已有內容之外再補充一項。
words.example: The centre offers evening classes as well.

exercises.original: The centre offers weekend classes. In addition, it offers evening classes.
exercises.zh: 中心提供週末課程，也提供晚間課程。

options.explanation: as well = as well 通常放句尾，表示在已有服務之外『也』提供另一項。
instead = evening classes 沒有取代 weekend classes。

exercises.original: She manages the budget. In addition, she supervises two junior staff.
exercises.zh: 她負責預算，也督導兩名初級員工。

options.explanation: instead = 不是改做另一工作。
therefore = supervision 不是管理 budget 的結果。
as well = 在前一職責之外再補充另一職責，句尾 as well 很自然。

exercises.original: The app works on phones. In addition, it works on tablets.
exercises.zh: 這個應用程式可在手機使用，也可在平板電腦使用。

options.explanation: however = 兩個平台並不對立。
instead = 不是只在 tablet 而不在 phone。
as well = 補充另一個兼容平台時，as well 是自然日常說法。

words.note: 口語、帶強調，表示在已有情況上再加一項，常用於列舉優點、問題或負擔。
words.example: The journey was delayed, and on top of that, our luggage was lost.
words.exampleZh: 旅程已經延誤，而且行李還遺失了。

exercises.original: The train was delayed. In addition, the air conditioning stopped working.
exercises.zh: 火車已經延誤，而且空調還停止運作。
exercises.upgrade: on top of that · 除此之外；而且

options.explanation: however = 第二件事不是對第一件事的轉折。
therefore = 空調故障不是列車延誤的必然結果。
on top of that = 兩個問題接連出現，口語強調累加負擔時 on top of that 很自然。

exercises.original: The apartment is expensive. In addition, it is a long way from the station.
exercises.zh: 這間公寓很貴，而且離車站很遠。
exercises.upgrade: on top of that · 除此之外；而且

options.explanation: therefore = 距離遠不是價格高的結果。
on top of that = 第二個缺點疊加在第一個缺點之上，因此 on top of that 最貼切。

exercises.original: We had to pay for repairs. In addition, we lost several days of work.
exercises.zh: 我們不但要支付維修費，而且還損失了數天工作時間。
exercises.upgrade: on top of that · 除此之外；而且

options.explanation: therefore = loss of workdays 未必是 repair payment 的直接結果。
on top of that = 額外損失令整體情況更差，on top of that 有合適的累加強調。

words.note: 較正式，常見於報告和論證，用來補充另一點；句首用法比 furthermore 更精簡。
words.example: Further, the data suggests that demand is still increasing.
words.exampleZh: 此外，數據顯示需求仍在上升。

exercises.original: The report notes that costs are rising. In addition, demand remains uncertain.
exercises.zh: 報告指出成本正在上升。此外，需求仍然不明朗。

options.explanation: however = 兩點並非互相對立。
therefore = uncertain demand 不是 rising costs 的結果。
further = 正式報告中精簡補充另一點，可用句首 Further。

exercises.original: The review found weaknesses in training. In addition, it identified gaps in supervision.
exercises.zh: 檢討發現培訓方面有不足。此外，亦辨識出督導上的缺口。

options.explanation: however = 兩項 findings 同方向。
therefore = supervision gaps 不是 training weakness 的推論。
similarly = 不是比較兩個案例。
further = 正式地列出另一項 finding 時，Further 很自然。

exercises.original: The data shows a fall in sales. In addition, customer enquiries have declined.
exercises.zh: 數據顯示銷售下降。此外，客戶查詢亦有所減少。

options.explanation: further = 在分析中補充另一項支持性數據，Further 很合適。
therefore = 查詢下降未必是 sales decline 的結果。

words.note: 完整、清楚的銜接語，適合正式或半正式寫作，用來承接前一句並加入另一項資訊。
words.example: In addition to this, the company will provide technical support.
words.exampleZh: 除此之外，公司還會提供技術支援。

exercises.original: The library has extended its opening hours. In addition, it has added more study spaces.
exercises.zh: 圖書館延長了開放時間。除此之外，亦增加了更多自修空間。
exercises.upgrade: in addition to this · 除此之外；此外

options.explanation: therefore = 增加 study spaces 不是延長時間的結果。
in addition to this = 第二句完整承接前項並加入另一措施，In addition to this 清楚自然。

exercises.original: The company will upgrade its website. In addition, it will provide staff training.
exercises.zh: 公司會升級網站。除此之外，亦會提供員工培訓。
exercises.upgrade: in addition to this · 除此之外；此外

options.explanation: in addition to this = 兩項獨立改進並列，較完整的正式銜接語 In addition to this 很合適。
therefore = training 不是 website upgrade 的必然結果。
however = 兩項都是計劃內容。

exercises.original: The scheme offers financial advice. In addition, participants can attend free workshops.
exercises.zh: 計劃提供財務建議。除此之外，參加者還可出席免費工作坊。
exercises.upgrade: in addition to this · 除此之外；此外

options.explanation: in addition to this = 第二個 benefit 是在第一個之外再提供，因此此銜接語最直接。
therefore = workshops 不是 advice 的結果。

words.note: 較口語，常用於日常對話、廣告或輕鬆寫作，表示再加上一項理由、好處或事實。
words.example: The hotel is inexpensive, plus it's only five minutes from the station.
words.exampleZh: 這間酒店價格便宜，而且離車站只有五分鐘。

exercises.original: The café is inexpensive. In addition, it stays open late.
exercises.zh: 這間咖啡店價格便宜，而且營業至很晚。

options.explanation: plus = 日常口語中快速加上一項優點，Plus 很自然。
therefore = 營業時間不是價格的結果。

exercises.original: This route is shorter. In addition, there is less traffic.
exercises.zh: 這條路較短，而且車流較少。

options.explanation: plus = 第二項是另一個支持選擇此路線的理由，口語可用 Plus。
therefore = traffic less 不是 shorter 的結果。
similarly = 不是在比較兩個相似案例。

exercises.original: The package includes delivery. In addition, installation is free.
exercises.zh: 套裝包括送貨，而且安裝免費。

options.explanation: therefore = free installation 不是 delivery 的結果。
however = 兩項 benefit 並不衝突。
plus = 廣告或日常說明中加入另一項好處，Plus 很自然。

falseSynonyms.zh: 然而不是此外 however 用來表示轉折或對比；in addition 用來加入同方向資訊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The plan is cheap. However, it may be unreliable. In addition, it is easy to use.

falseSynonyms.zh: 因此不是此外 therefore 表示結果或推論；in addition 只是補充另一點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The road was closed; therefore, we took another route. In addition, we left early.

falseSynonyms.zh: 反而／改為不是此外 instead 表示替代；in addition 表示在原有內容上再增加。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We did not drive; instead, we took the train. In addition, we walked part of the way.

falseSynonyms.zh: 同樣地不等於此外 similarly 強調兩件事相似；in addition 不要求新增內容與前項相似。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Similarly links comparable ideas; in addition simply adds another point.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞不等於連接語 addition 是名詞，表示增加物或加法；in addition 才能作銜接語表示『此外』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The addition increased the cost. In addition, it delayed the project.

falseSynonyms.zh: 獨立連接語與介系詞結構不同 in addition 可獨立連接句子；in addition to 後面必須接名詞、代名詞或動名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON In addition, we hired more staff. In addition to hiring more staff, we extended the deadline.

falseSynonyms.zh: 位置和語氣不同 also 通常放句中；too 常放句尾。兩者可同樣表示『也』，但句法位置不能總是直接交換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She also works weekends. She works weekends too.

falseSynonyms.zh: 補充與讓步不同 moreover 加入同方向論點；nevertheless 表示即使如此、帶讓步轉折。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The plan is affordable; moreover, it is practical. It is risky; nevertheless, we may proceed.
